reason: The beans must be gathered before they can be cooked, and the lined basket is suited to harvesting.
expectation: The basket will collect the mature soybean pods.

effect: The soybean pods are gathered and ready for preparation.
reaction: It is satisfying to harvest from the row that survived the storm.
reason: The pods may need shelling before cooking, so I will check how they can be prepared.
expectation: The inspection should reveal the next available preparation step.

alternatives.reason: I could try cooking them directly, but the pods may need preparation first.

effect: The pods are shelled, leaving dry soybeans ready for cooking.
reaction: The automatic shelling was a useful clarification.
reason: The beans need thorough cooking, and the solar cooking pot is available.
expectation: The beans will go into the pot for cooking, possibly with water.

effect: The beans need water before they can go into the pot.
reaction: The compatibility feedback clarifies the preparation order.
reason: Drinking water is the listed partner for the dry soybeans.
expectation: The water will prepare the beans for cooking.

effect: The beans are soaked, drained and ready for the cooking vessel.
reaction: The preparation order is clear now.
reason: The soaked beans are ready for the solar cooking pot.
expectation: The beans will cook thoroughly in the pot.

effect: The soybeans are fully cooked, and the next goal is to add potatoes and serve the stew with lettuce.
reaction: The separate bean-cooking programme makes the order of preparation clear.
reason: The potatoes must be harvested before they can join the cooked beans; the basket has already worked for harvesting.
expectation: The basket will collect the mature potatoes.

effect: The potatoes are harvested, washed and cut, ready to join the cooked beans.
reaction: The substantial harvest makes the earlier planting feel worthwhile.
reason: The prepared potatoes can now be added to the cooked soybeans for the stew.
expectation: The potatoes will cook with the beans to make stew.

effect: The potatoes and beans are cooked together; fresh lettuce is still needed to serve the meal.
reaction: The second heating makes the cooking sequence feel practical.
reason: The basket previously harvested lettuce from this tray, and the meal still needs fresh leaves.
expectation: I will harvest fresh lettuce leaves to serve with the stew.

effect: The basket cannot currently harvest the lettuce, so I need another way to prepare it.
reaction: That was surprising given the earlier harvest.
reason: Inspecting the lettuce tray should reveal its available preparation step.
expectation: The inspection will identify how to obtain lettuce for the meal.

effect: Inspecting the lettuce tray automatically combined it with the stew and completed the meal and chapter.
reaction: The supper was a satisfying payoff for the crops kept alive through the storm, though the direct tray-to-stew combination surprised me.

mostWorthwhile.text: Cooking the soaked beans separately before adding potatoes made the meal’s preparation understandable and physically sensible; the finished supper tied it to the earlier farm story.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the harvest basket on the lettuce was unproductive, especially because it had worked for harvesting before.

surprise.text: Inspecting the lettuce tray immediately combined it with the stew, including picking and washing the leaves.

arbitrary.text: The basket could gather soybeans and potatoes but could not be used on the lettuce tray, despite the earlier lettuce harvest; the distinction was not clear.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the expedition and specimens reach Earth; this chapter’s harvest was a satisfying story payoff, despite the confusing lettuce interaction.
